FLIP.title: My Journey
FLIP.subtitle: The evolution of an engineer: from fundamental mathematics to applied artificial intelligence

flip1.title: Baccalaureate – Science Series (Series D)
flip1.fullDescription: Obtained my Baccalaureate Series D at Lycée Aného Ville in Togo. This scientific track provided me with a solid foundation in mathematics, physics, and natural sciences, forming the basis of my current analytical rigor.

flip2.title: Bachelor’s Degree in Fundamental Mathematics
flip2.fullDescription: Bachelor’s degree obtained at the University of Lomé. Throughout this academic program, I developed strong skills in abstraction, logical reasoning, and solving complex problems. These abilities served as a bridge toward computer science, especially algorithmics and modeling.

flip3.title: Mathematics Teacher
flip3.fullDescription: Math teacher at Complexe Scolaire Le Savoir in Lomé. For four years, I taught mathematics to secondary school students, designed adapted teaching methods, and prepared learners for national exams. This experience strengthened my communication and pedagogical skills.

flip4.title: Discovery Internship in Software Development
flip4.fullDescription: First immersion in applied computer science at TECHNO MEGA PARTNERS, involving practical work in web development and programming. This experience confirmed my decision to fully transition into software engineering and artificial intelligence.

flip5.title: Academic & Professional Internships
flip5.fullDescription: Completed two internships at Techno Méga Partners in Libreville: a development internship (CEVIMEC & TAM) and an engineering internship in AI (ARCHIFILE). I contributed to the design of business applications, full-stack development (Angular, Spring Boot, FastAPI), and the creation of an intelligent archiving solution integrating an AI chatbot, automated indexing, and hybrid search.

flip6.title: Software Engineering Degree
flip6.fullDescription: Engineering training at the African Institute of Computer Science (IAI) in Libreville. Specialized in application design, software engineering, data science, and artificial intelligence. My projects include: RAG chatbot, microservices systems, computer vision solutions, decision-making ETL, and Angular/Spring Boot applications.
